content: श्रम् €4 <ab>P.</ab> (श्राम्यति, श्रान्त) .²1 To exert oneself, take pains, toil, labour. .²2 To perform austerities, mortify the body (by acts of penance); क्रियच्चिरं श्राम्यसि गौरि <ls>Ku. 5. 50</ls>. .²3 To be wearied or fatigued, be exhausted; रतिश्रान्ता शेते रजनिरमणी गाढमुरसि <ls>K. P. 10</ls>; <ls>Śi. 14. 38</ls>; <ls>Bk. 14. 110</ls>. .²4 To be afflicted or distressed; यो वृन्दानि त्वरयति पथि श्राम्यतां प्रोषितानाम् <ls>Me. 101</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (श्र(श्रा)मयति-ते) To cause to be fatigued <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To overcome, conquer, subdue.
